reviews.title: Kagi
reviews.pros:
Great search results.

Best incorporation of ai I've seen in a search engine.

Lots of nice extra features.
reviews.cons: The price is a bit steep but when you compare the price to value ratio it feels more worthwhile.
reviews.overall: My overall experience has been pretty good there isn't anything I can really complain about other than the price. I used it as my default search engine every day and I never have to worry about switching search engines to find the results I'm looking for like I had to with other search engines.
